title: EXT_voxels glTF Node extension
description: `EXT_voxels` extension for a node in a glTF model to indicate voxel-based volumetric data

dimensions.description: Dimensions of the voxel grid. The values are interpreted with respect to the shape indicated by `shape`.

padding.description: The optional padding of the voxels.

attributes.description: A plain JSON object, where each key corresponds to an attribute semantic and each value is the index of the accessor containing the attribute's data.

noData.description: A plain JSON object, where each key corresponds to an existing semantic in `attributes`, and each value is the attribute's `noData` value. A `noData` value represents missing data—also known as a sentinel value—wherever it appears.

additionalProperties.description: The `noData` value for the corresponding attribute. Array elements **MUST** follow the accessor's `componentType`, and its length must align with the accessor's `type`.
